events.what_it_is: An in-person NYFW model casting call from Indie Fashion & Arts Network.
events.what_is_free: No admission charge is shown for models who bring a professional headshot or comp card.

events.caveats: The supplied screenshot promotes a GFC × Crescala showroom at the same venue and dates, but the official GFC page clearly verifies the runway program rather than public showroom access.
